content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":true,"reason":"Also builds and sells single-family and attached homes to first-time and move-up buyers, with ancillary title and mortgage services."},{"label":"C2","good":true,"reason":"Builds and sells single-family homes and townhomes to first-time and move-up buyers, with in-house mortgage and title services."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Sells finished lots to homebuilders as a B2B land developer; it does not build or sell homes to consumers."},{"label":"C4","good":true,"reason":"Builds and sells single-family homes and townhomes to individual buyers, develops lots, and arranges buyer mortgages."},{"label":"C5","good":true,"reason":"Builds and sells single-family detached and attached homes to first-time, move-up and active adult buyers, with mortgage services."},{"label":"C6","good":true,"reason":"Builds and sells single-family homes and townhomes to individual buyers, with mortgage, title and insurance services attached."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Primarily an insurer underwriting title, mortgage guaranty and commercial policies; it does not build or sell homes."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Mainly life insurance and cemetery/mortuary businesses; its mortgage lending is a minor side line, not homebuilding."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"A title insurer and real estate software provider selling to lenders and agents; it does not build or sell homes."}]}
